what_it_does: This work addresses data sharing challenges in multi-robot systems (teams of drones and ground vehicles) by introducing ROSfs, a custom filesystem layer that handles real-time data queries across robots. The filesystem intelligently organizes robot data by time-based tags, allowing other robots to quickly fetch recent sensor readings or logs without scanning disk. Tests on actual UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) and UGV (unmanned ground vehicle) platforms show the system integrates naturally into existing Robot Operating System (ROS) ecosystems.
